geometry: Bloc de pierre unique rectangulaire, bas et epais, dessus plan, angles droits et aretes fines. Aucun socle ajoute, aucune stele.
material_zones: Pierre sombre mouchetee uniforme sur dessus et faces laterales.
ambiguity: Aucune ambiguite majeure. La perspective ne fournit pas de dimensions fiables.
generation_note: MODELE SANS STELE: ne pas inventer de plaque verticale, vase, cadre, croix, motif ou marche.
decisionPilote: Modele sans stele : une dalle unique, sans socle ajoute. Aucune dimension physique fiable deduite de la perspective.

specificationGeneration.geometry: a compact cinerary monument consisting of one single low thick rectangular stone slab with a flat top and straight sides, without a headstone
specificationGeneration.stoneAreas: all visible surfaces of the single rectangular stone slab
specificationGeneration.fixedAreas: Preserve this as one solid slab only, with its original thickness, flat top, straight sides and fine edges.
specificationGeneration.extraConstraints: Do not add a headstone, vertical plaque, second plinth, frame, step, vase, cross, engraving or other component.
specificationGeneration.masterDescription: Preserve exactly the single low thick rectangular stone block, its planar horizontal top, straight vertical side faces, right-angled footprint and fine edges. There is no separate base beneath it and no upright element.
specificationGeneration.removeDescription: No removable accessories or surface decorations are present.
